game.title: Metaphor: ReFantazio
game.blurb: Fantasy turn-based RPG from Studio Zero and Atlus, released 2024-10-11. RAWG average playtime: 27 hours (well under a full run). Genres: Action, Adventure, RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: The journey toward the royal election and the throne, step by step.

chapters.title: Archetypes and Combat
chapters.summary: Mastering Archetypes, Synthesis skills, stuns, ambushes and battle tricks.

chapters.title: Followers and Daily Life
chapters.summary: Followers, cooking, books, debates and time spent with your companions.

chapters.title: Quests, Bounties and Challenges
chapters.summary: Side quests, bounties, Elmentas, the coliseum and the test of courage.

chapters.title: Travel and the Wider World
chapters.summary: Visiting every town, unlocking the map, journey drawings, blade-riding, gold beetles and shopping.

notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0); Walkthrough, Gameplay, Controls and Achievements subpages are linked but not written, and only a Table of Contents subpage exists. The game is covered on megamitensei.fandom.com (the Megami Tensei wiki), which answers the API with about 466 linked pages; names only were looked at, nothing copied. 13 of 44 Steam achievements are hidden; they sit in the main story chapter (Entrusted and His Majesty may be side content and need checking). The "acquire all achievements" one sits in the combat chapter by default.
